duplicatedPatterns.detail: Driver and invitation bands repeat heading/count/refresh/state/table orchestration. Their actions and columns differ; no evidence that another universal panel is necessary.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Prefer existing section/layout and data-state owners; retain clear domain orchestration rather than introducing another shared panel abstraction.

Panel padding changes at sm and headers/actions wrap (page:323-324,385-396).
Refresh text hidden below sm while localized aria-label remains (page:338,402).

issues.detail: Driver mobileColumns excludes email. Invitation mobileColumns at line 433 excludes createdBy and link, so the Copy invite link action disappears below md. DataTable.tsx:238-248,715-725 implements excluded columns as hidden md:table-cell. Neither caller supplies mobilePresentation or a row-details alternative.
issues.fix: Reuse DataTable's existing opt-in mobile presentation/detail contract, or preserve all columns in a contained scroll strategy. Ensure email/creator and invitation Copy remain reachable on mobile without losing selection/filter/pagination behavior.

responsive.viewportAcceptance: UNVERIFIED at 320,375,390,430,768,1024,1280,1440,1920,2560; no mounted UI or allocated-container test.

sourceStrengths: Localized action aria-labels; action SVGs explicitly aria-hidden.
Invitation statuses include visible text, not color alone.
Shared confirmations, table, timestamp and clipboard primitives reused.

issues.detail: Driver remove and invitation revoke buttons use size=sm; shared Button.tsx:38-42 defines sm height 36px and md height 40px. No caller supplies a 44px touch target. Spacing exception compliance is not measured.
issues.fix: Use existing supported sizing/class hooks to reach the mobile target without overlap; validate actual target spacing rather than declaring a WCAG failure from height alone.

issues.detail: Neither destructive dialog supplies loading, although removeDriver/revokeInvitation remain pending until settlement. ConfirmDialog.tsx:23-25,130-147,185-202 already supports disabling confirmation/cancel while pending; without this prop repeat confirmation remains possible.
issues.fix: Pass each existing mutation isPending to its dialog loading prop; retain danger confirmation, route ids, valid share_user_id=0, and settlement semantics. Validate one request per confirmation and focus restoration without performing real access mutations.

accessibility.acceptance: Keyboard, focus trap/restoration, screen reader, contrast, forced colors, reduced motion and touch behavior UNVERIFIED.

states.initialLoading: Each list has a 220px Skeleton; shared brief loading is driversLoading OR invitationsLoading.
states.empty: Per-source explanatory EmptyState and always-present shells; overview empty only when both totals zero.
states.fatalError: Each table uses its own fatalError/QueryError/retry; shared stale notices retain previously loaded records.
states.staleOffline: useDataState retains payload; StaleRefreshWarning handles paused/offline vs refresh error at dependency:57-84.
states.mutations: Refresh/create buttons show isPending; hooks emit success/error toast and scoped invalidation. Destructive confirmations omit pending-state binding.

issues.detail: Overview uses combined loading and fatal-error booleans. AccessOverviewPanel.tsx:82-90 replaces its entire body when either source is loading/fatally failed, hiding the healthy neighbor's role or invitation breakdown even when available.
issues.fix: Represent drivers and invitation subsections independently using the existing DataState contract; retain available breakdowns and provide source-specific skeleton/error/retry in the unavailable subsection.

issues.detail: Brief maps every missing source to partial, including both sources failing or still unresolved; loading OR at line 308 also suppresses healthy metrics while the other source initially loads. VehicleEvidenceBrief already supports initial and initialFailure labels but they are never selected here. No freshness prop is passed despite source updatedAt and fetched_at metadata.
issues.fix: Derive accurate aggregate trust with existing useCombinedDataState, retaining independently available counts. Supply truthful source freshness through existing freshness/provenance props; do not equate query fetch time with Tesla record fetched_at.

visualIssues.detail: Invitation status distribution defines five literal hex colors. AccessOverviewPanel.tsx:116-122 forwards them into MetricBar without opting into its solid fill, so shared default gradient is used. Action/icon classes at page:217,264,280,326,388 also hardcode rose/cyan shades rather than theme-aware semantic tokens.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse existing semantic severity/theme tokens for status and action presentation, and MetricBar fill=solid (already supported). Preserve status labels, distribution counts and user palette preferences; do not add a palette or reset themes.

architectureIssues.detail: Seven-day expiry count captures Date.now inside useMemo keyed only to invitationsList. A retained unchanged list does not recompute as time crosses expiry/window boundaries, so the time-sensitive summary can become outdated.
architectureIssues.fix: Use an existing shared clock/time refresh mechanism if available, or a bounded page-owned clock with cleanup; keep pending-only, future-only, finite timestamp and inclusive seven-day boundary semantics. No unit conversion or endpoint change.

architectureIssues.detail: Driver role table displays raw row.role, while overview localizes vehicleAccess.role.* with titleCase fallback (AccessOverviewPanel.tsx:133-135). Same role identity has inconsistent presentation.
architectureIssues.fix: Apply existing localized role labels consistently at rendering/filter-label boundaries without changing raw role or filter identity, source casing, or unknown fallback.

preservation.mountedFeatureLineCountFormula: 465 page + 145 AccessOverviewPanel + 43 VehicleEvidenceBrief; excludes unmounted AccessKpiBand, barrel and tests.
sectionNames: Access summary (four counts and review drawer)
Access overview (invitation statuses and driver roles)
actions: Copy existing invitation URL with feedback
Independent filtering/pagination and existing table controls
dataBehavior: Route id determines all page requests/mutations, not a newly introduced selector.
share_user_id=0 remains valid and removable; only null/undefined prevent removal.
Only pending invitations expose revoke; only existing invite_url exposes copy.
Independent nullable arrays remain null-safe; missing summary inputs remain null, resolved empty arrays give real zero counts.
Pending and expiring-soon counts derive from the same raw invitations as table/overview; seven days is 7*86400000 milliseconds, future finite expiry only.
Sort status and role breakdowns descending by count; retain every source status/role identity including unknown.
Retain source cache keys, enablement, abort signal, standard staleness, scoped invalidation and toast behavior.
Expiry uses shared TimeStamp preferences; count metrics use existing formatting bridge; no physical-unit conversion required.
Latest access snapshots are not historical date-scoped analytics; no extra workspace date/vehicle picker is introduced.

workspace.detail: Range enablement is exact-path opt-in; page consumes route id and renders no competing scope controls. Selected-vehicle navigation coordination beyond this page was not runtime verified.

preservation.trust: Keep per-source retained records visible on refresh failure/offline and fatal-only replacement. Never fabricate records, zero unknown values, or drop access-management capabilities.
